supersedes.reason: Byleth was a fixed right-edge portrait across anchors and the rebels read as a flat repeated shield wall.

positive_findings: START makes Byleth cross into the physical road instead of posing at the edge.
KEY gives Byleth a readable low stop gesture and creates foreground/midground/background rebel depth.
END turns Byleth toward the Dimitri handoff and limits the rebels to one final non-graphic step.
The v2 contact sheet shows distinct blocking and camera-readable progression.
remaining_risks: Motion may drift the female face, professor wardrobe, or soldier costume.
The small formation may duplicate faces or flatten into a wall during motion.
Japanese chant timing and the Dimitri handoff need a 3-second probe.
reject_if: Byleth becomes a static right-edge portrait or rear silhouette
Byleth becomes war-phase, older, or sexualized
rebels become clones, an endless army, or a flat repeated shield wall
spear impact, gore, magic, subtitles, UI, Chinese voice, Mandarin voice, borders, or artificial side fill appears
START/KEY/END collapse into the old fixed pose
required_next_gate: Run 3-second motion probe before approved_for_video promotion.
